origins.section: A Product of Two Binaries Is Their AND, Written as Three Rows
The Sign of the Product's Term Decides Which Rows It Needs
The Bounds in the Rows Are Part of the Formulation

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-and-rows: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-and-rows: a new binary $`z_{ab}`$ with $`z_{ab} \le x_a, \qquad z_{ab} \le x_b, \qquad z_{ab} \ge x_a + x_b - 1`$
recorded.prompt:q-charged-product: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-charged-product: A cost on $`z`$ (a negative term in a maximization) makes the solver push $`z`$ down, so the row that pushes it up is the one that matters. Without it, the solver sets every $`z`$ to 0, pays no coordination cost
recorded.prompt:q-loose-bound: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-loose-bound: any $`U' \ge U`$ still gives $`w = x\,q`$ at every 0/1 point. ... A looser bound keeps the MILP and weakens the LP.

recorded.prompt:q-and-rows:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-and-rows:a: These are the OR rows: "For $`z = a \text{ OR } b`$: $`z \ge x_a, \qquad z \ge x_b, \qquad z \le x_a + x_b`$"
recorded.prompt:q-and-rows:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-and-rows:b: Applying the truth table ("0 | 0 | 0"): at x_a = x_b = 0 the row gives z = -1, which no binary z can take, so the row refuses a 0/1 point the product allows.
recorded.prompt:q-and-rows:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-and-rows:c: Applying the truth table: at (1,1) the rows give z <= 2 and z >= 0, so z = 0 is allowed where the product is 1. These are not the page's rows.
recorded.prompt:q-charged-product:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-charged-product:a: "rows down     claims $25,336k with  0 pairs; the plan has  7 pairs"
recorded.prompt:q-charged-product:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-charged-product:b: "makes the solver push $`z`$ down", and z_ab <= x_a, z_ab <= x_b forbid z = 1 with one project unfunded.
recorded.prompt:q-charged-product:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-charged-product:d: "the solver sets every $`z`$ to 0". z = 0 satisfies both rows and the run returns a plan.
recorded.prompt:q-loose-bound:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-loose-bound:a: "any $`U' \ge U`$ still gives $`w = x\,q`$ at every 0/1 point"
recorded.prompt:q-loose-bound:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-loose-bound:c: "The LP bound rises from $25,983.20k to $26,043.95k, further from the true $25,904.9k, and with 600 further still."
recorded.prompt:q-loose-bound:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-loose-bound:d: Table rows "60 | ... | $25,904.9k" and "600 | ... | $25,904.9k": the MILP is unchanged with bounds far above the range.
